# Disagreement Log — GTH_083

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 83
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 83 | "manifest to the human being" | "visible to mankind" | "People can see the images" | *ouonkh ebol*: manifest vs. visible |
| 2 | 83 | "He will become manifest" | "He will be revealed" | "That light will appear" | Subject of manifestation: He (Father) vs. that light |
| 3 | 83 | "his image will be hidden by his light" | "his image will be concealed by his light" | "the image will be veiled by it" | Concealment verb: hidden vs. concealed vs. veiled |

**Total disagreements: 3**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA follows EMET: "manifest to the human being," "He will become manifest," and "hidden by his light."
